sn1.75:1.1: Kiṃsūdha bhīrā janatā anekā || maggo v-anekāyatanaṃ pavutto || pucchāmi taṃ Gotama bhūripañña || kismiṃ ṭhito paralokaṃ na bhāye ti || ||
sn1.75:2.1: Vācaṃ manañca paṇidhāya sammā || kāyena pāpāni akubbamāno || bahvannapānaṃ gharam āvasanto || saddho mudū {saṃvibhāgī} vadaññū || etesu dhammesu ṭhito catusu || paralokaṃ na bhāye ti || ||
